candidate.user_input: What are the full eligibility criteria for a GitLab employee to use the Growth and Development Fund?
candidate.reference: To use the Growth and Development Fund, applicants must be full-time GitLab employees who meet performance expectations in their role and are not on leave status.
reference_contexts:
## Eligibility

To use the Growth and Development Fund, applicants must be full-time GitLab employees who meet performance expectations in their role and are not on leave status.
